verse_changes.before: I will kill her children with death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give each of you according to your works.
verse_changes.after: I will put her children to death. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who searches kidneys and hearts, and I will give each of you according to your works.
verse_changes.rationale: Render the emphatic death expression in natural English without specifying plague or changing children to an explanatory label; retain the literal/plague possibility in the note.

verse_changes.before: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be their God, and they will be my son.
verse_changes.after: The one who overcomes will inherit these things. I will be that person's God, and that person will be my son.
verse_changes.rationale: Make the singular generic recipient explicit while preserving the scriptural sonship formula and the promised inheritance.
